text.text: Every uchigatana carries a preset slash art chosen by its material: fire materials sweep, pierce thrusts, heavy materials spin, soul eaters cut the void, berserkers and unstable blades drop cherry blossoms.
SlashBlades only release a slash art when enchanted. A forged blade already carries a name, so enchanting it makes it a bewitched blade.
The steel itself is tinted by the material as well: thirty-seven materials, thirty-seven blade colours.
